rows.question: Q1
rows.rubricFeedback: Chose correct primary keys for Student, Course and Enrolment but never declared Enrolment.courseId as a foreign key referencing Course, so the referential-integrity mark was lost.

rows.question: Q2
rows.rubricFeedback: Produced a correct expression, but σ dept = 'CS' stayed above the Student ⋈ Enrolment join instead of being pushed below it as the optimised form required.

rows.question: Q3
rows.rubricFeedback: Computed {B}+ as {B, C} and stopped before applying C → D, so D was missing from the closure.

rows.question: Q4a
rows.rubricFeedback: Took {studentId, courseId} as the key but missed the partial dependency studentId → studentName, so the relation was placed in 2NF when it is only in 1NF.

rows.question: Q4b
rows.rubricFeedback: Decomposed into R1(studentId, courseId, grade) and R2(studentId, studentName, advisorId, advisorOffice), leaving the transitive dependency studentId → advisorId → advisorOffice inside R2, so the result is not in 3NF.

rows.question: Q4c
rows.rubricFeedback: Called Teaches(student, course, instructor) BCNF because every attribute is prime, but instructor → course has a determinant that is not a superkey, which 3NF allows and BCNF does not.

rows.question: Q5a
rows.rubricFeedback: Split the overflowing leaf when 42 was inserted but did not copy the new separator key up into the already-full parent, so the parent split and the new root were missing from the final tree.

rows.question: Q5b
rows.rubricFeedback: Answered the range query 20 ≤ key ≤ 45 with a separate root-to-leaf search for every key instead of one search for 20 followed by a walk along the linked leaf level.

rows.question: Q1
rows.rubricFeedback: Drew the five-state diagram with an arc straight from Waiting to Running, but a process whose I/O completes goes back to Ready and has to be dispatched again.

rows.question: Q2
rows.rubricFeedback: Listed the open-file table as private to each thread, but open files, the heap and global variables are shared by every thread of the process.

rows.question: Q3
rows.rubricFeedback: Counted every system call as a context switch, but a system call is a user-to-kernel mode switch within the same process unless the scheduler then picks a different process.

rows.question: Q4a
rows.rubricFeedback: Built the FCFS Gantt chart correctly but filled the waiting-time column with turnaround times (completion minus arrival), so the average waiting time was overstated.

rows.question: Q4b
rows.rubricFeedback: Drew the Round Robin Gantt chart with the 4 ms quantum but added no 1 ms context-switch slot between slices, so every completion time after the first slice and the average turnaround time came out too low.

rows.question: Q4c
rows.rubricFeedback: Ran SJF non-preemptively although the question asked for SRTF, so P2 (2 ms burst, arriving at t = 1) never preempted P1 and every later start time was wrong.
